history.text: Swahili city-states such as Lamu and Mombasa traded across the Indian Ocean.
Britain declared the East Africa Protectorate.
The Uganda Railway reached Lake Victoria, founding Nairobi on the way.
The Mau Mau uprising was fought against colonial rule.
Independence came on 12 December, with Jomo Kenyatta as first leader.
A new constitution devolved power to 47 counties.

worthSeeing.title: Maasai Mara:
worthSeeing.text: The northern extension of the Serengeti, crossed by the annual wildebeest migration.

worthSeeing.title: Mount Kenya:
worthSeeing.text: Africa's second-highest peak, with glaciers on the equator.

worthSeeing.title: Lamu Old Town:
worthSeeing.text: A Swahili trading town of coral stone, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
